def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n = inputs["n"]
    k = inputs["k"]
    
    # Josephus problem: find survivor position (1-indexed)
    # Using dynamic programming approach
    # positions are 0-indexed internally, convert to 1-indexed at end
    
    positions = list(range(1, n + 1))
    idx = 0
    
    while len(positions) > 1:
        idx = (idx + k - 1) % len(positions)
        positions.pop(idx)
    
    return float(positions[0])
